name: Susie Wolff
profile: Scottish former racing driver (Formula Renault, DTM for Mercedes-Benz, Williams F1 test driver 2012-15). Team Principal and shareholder of Venturi Racing in Formula E from 2018, CEO from 2021, leaving in 2022. Since 2023 runs F1 Academy, the all-female series. Shares Rich List wealth with husband Toto Wolff.
interesting_fact: At the 2014 British Grand Prix she became the first woman to take part in a Formula 1 race weekend in 22 years.
deep_cut_fact: Born Suzanne Stoddart in Oban, where her parents ran a motorcycle dealership; she started karting at eight and was British Woman Kart Racing Driver of the Year in 1996-99. She left an international business degree at Edinburgh to turn pro, and the university later made her an Honorary Fellow (2013).
notes: Official site has a Contact page; also books speaking through agencies. Founded Dare To Be Different (2016) to promote women in motorsport.

name: Chen Yangnan
profile: Listed on Hurun China 2018-2021 with wealth from 'Huayu' (real estate). Searches did not find a source linking Chen Yangnan (陈阳南) to a specific Huayu company; several unrelated firms use the name, e.g. Chongqing developer Huayu.
notes: Identity not confirmed. Need the full Huayu company name or city to research further.

name: Wu Zhenling
current_role: Executive director / vice chairman, Tian Shan Development (Holding) Ltd (HK:2118); company in liquidation since 2023
profile: Co-founder of Shijiazhuang-based Tian Shan Development (Holding), the Hebei property developer listed in Hong Kong (2118); Wu Zhen Shan is chairman. A May 2023 HKEX announcement put the company in liquidation with trading suspended, and still named him an executive director. Also linked to Hebei Tianshan Shuzhi Electronic Technology.
interesting_fact: Before Tian Shan, he founded a Shijiazhuang Hi-Tech Zone construction & engineering company in 1995. Tian Shan Development (Holding) was founded in 2005.
deep_cut_fact: He has been vice chairman of the Project Construction Quality Branch of the Hebei Construction Association (since July 2011).
notes: Hurun lists the company as 'Tianshan'. Tian Shan Development is in liquidation (HKEX, May 2023: https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2023/0505/2023050501389.pdf). Wealth figure is likely stale. No published contact found.

name: Kuai Jiaqi
current_role: Founder and former chairman & CEO of Dada Group (stepped down 31 Aug 2022); no current public role found
profile: MIT-trained logistics engineer who founded Dada in July 2014 with Sequoia backing. It is a crowdsourced same-city instant-delivery platform that merged with JD to Home in 2016 and listed on Nasdaq (DADA) in June 2020. He stepped down as chairman and CEO in August 2022. Reports said he might turn to investing and mentoring founders.
interesting_fact: Within about a year of launch, Dada reportedly had over 100,000 delivery couriers on its crowdsourced platform.
deep_cut_fact: Before Dada he co-founded online ad platform AdChina (易传媒) and then joined property-listing site Anjuke, both later acquired. He decided that staying independent meant picking industries where both supply and demand are fragmented, citing Uber.
notes: On leaving he said: 'The past eight years have been a very exciting journey' (https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_19573756). No personal public contact found. Dada IR is the institutional route, but it is now under JD.

name: Chen Gonghai
current_role: Chairman and co-actual controller, Henan BCCY Environmental Energy Co. (百川畅银, 300614.SZ)
profile: Co-founder and chairman of Henan BCCY Environmental Energy (百川畅银, 300614.SZ), described as China's largest biogas (landfill-gas) power investor-operator. It has expanded into carbon-reduction trading and mobile energy-storage heating. He and Li Na are the actual controllers. In Jan 2026 they agreed to sell about 10% to Jiangsu Energy without changing control.
interesting_fact: BCCY is described as China's largest biogas power generation investor-operator. It captures methane from landfills to generate electricity and earn carbon-reduction credits.
deep_cut_fact: In April 2017 he gave up the general manager post at BCCY (then 百川环能) to bring in management talent, appointing Zhang Feng, formerly of PowerChina Road & Bridge, as GM.
notes: Current-role and stake facts come from media citing filings (June 2026: ~27.45% held directly, Li Na ~4.82%): https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260604A069MJ00. No published personal contact found; use the company board secretary/IR. Relevant to energy themes (landfill gas, storage).

name: Liao Muzhi
current_role: Co-founder and non-executive director, Guangdong CHJ Industry (潮宏基, 002345.SZ)
profile: Gold trader from Chaoyang, Shantou, who in 1997 co-founded Shantou Chaohongji, the predecessor of jewellery brand CHJ, and served as its chairman. Before its 2010 Shenzhen listing he was the actual controller. His son Liao Chuangbin now chairs the company, and he remains a non-executive director in his late 70s.
interesting_fact: The brand name Chaohongji (潮鸿基) was meant to evoke '潮汕明珠，宏图大展，基业长青': pearl of Chaoshan, grand ambitions, an enduring foundation.
deep_cut_fact: He started as a 'gold broker' in Chaoyang, buying gold, having it processed on contract and reselling it. Around 1993, when HK/Taiwan-backed processors in Panyu and Shenzhen undercut family workshops, he decided the future was building a brand.
notes: Low public profile. Sources differ on the founding year (1996 vs 1997). The best route is CHJ's investor relations / board office (SZSE filings).

name: Dong Fangmei
current_role: Co-actual controller (with Li Ming) of Shenzhen Hui Chuang Da Technology (汇创达, 300909.SZ)
profile: Dong Fangmei and Li Ming are the actual controllers of Shenzhen Hui Chuang Da Technology, founded in 2004 and listed on ChiNext. It makes light-guide films, laptop keyboard backlight modules, metal-dome switches and micro waterproof tact switches using micro/nano hot-embossing. Ningbo Tongmu, a related holder acting in concert, planned in May 2026 to sell up to 3%.
interesting_fact: Hui Chuang Da builds its light-guide structures with in-house micro/nano hot-embossing, and supplies light-guide films and other functional parts to phone makers including Huawei, OPPO, vivo and Xiaomi.
interesting_fact_source: https://www.emis.cn/php/company-profile/CN/Shenzhen_Hui_Chuang_Da_Technology_Co_Ltd__深圳市汇创达科技股份有限公司__en_10032540.html
notes: Very low public profile; no personal biography found. Control relationship: https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202605153739106910.html. The route is the company board secretary/IR (see SZSE filings).

name: Cheng Xuegang
profile: On Hurun China 2005-2011 with wealth from 'Homevalue Group' (real estate and building materials). Searches in English and Chinese (成雪刚) found no source tying this name to a specific company.
notes: Identity not confirmed. Last listed in 2011; information is probably stale. The Chinese company name for 'Homevalue Group' is needed to research further.

name: Zhou Zhen
current_role: Shareholder (30%) and manager of a holding vehicle co-owned with Chen Hankang, the actual controller of Zhejiang Kangsheng (康盛股份, 002418.SZ)
profile: Listed on Hurun 2015-2017 alongside Chen Hankang for wealth from Kangsheng, the Zhejiang maker of tubular products (refrigeration pipes) listed in Shenzhen. A 2022 SZSE disclosure shows her owning 30% of, and serving as manager of, an entity in which Chen Hankang holds 70%. No other public biography was found.
notes: Very low profile. The source is SZSE filing https://disc.static.szse.cn/disc/disk03/finalpage/2022-09-22/ace8775b-1608-4541-8900-d6550e8a6a0c.PDF. Her relationship to Chen Hankang is not stated in the sources read. The Hurun-era wealth is likely stale.

name: Wang Yinxiang
current_role: Founder, Chairman and Co-CEO, Jacobio Pharmaceuticals (HKEX: 1167)
profile: Oncology scientist (PhD, University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences; Yale postdoc). Co-founded Betta Pharmaceuticals in 2003 with Ding Lieming and Zhang Xiaodong, and as president/CSO led development of icotinib (Conmana), approved in 2011. Left Betta around 2017 to build Jacobio, a Beijing biotech focused on KRAS/SHP2 cancer targets.
interesting_fact: Icotinib, which he led, is described as China's first small-molecule targeted anticancer drug. He and his co-founders became known as the 'Betta Three Musketeers' (贝达三剑客).
deep_cut_fact: While a Yale postdoc, he and Zhang Xiaodong discussed the idea of developing an anticancer drug targeting the EGFR kinase. That conversation became Betta's founding technical route. He first trained at the Graduate School of the Chinese Academy of Preventive Medicine.
notes: Hurun lists wealth under Betta, but his current company is Jacobio. He is vice chairman of PHIRDA's New Drug R&D Committee. The Yale/EGFR anecdote and the musketeers nickname come from news reports surfaced in search.

name: Ju Wanli
profile: On Hurun China 2021 (information technology). The listed source of wealth is just the person's own name. Searches in Chinese (巨万里) and English found no source identifying the company.
notes: Identity not confirmed; the company name is needed.

name: Jeffrey M Thompson
current_role: Chairman and CEO, Red Cat Holdings (Nasdaq: RCAT); director, Unusual Machines (UMAC)
profile: Serial telecom/tech founder who started Red Cat after leaving Towerstream, the fixed-wireless internet company he founded and ran as CEO from 2005 to 2016. He took Red Cat public via a 2019 reverse merger and built it into a US military drone maker. In Nov 2026 Red Cat reported Q3 revenue up 22% and launched an offer for Austria's Steyr Motors.
interesting_fact: Red Cat is expanding beyond drones. Its Blue Ops unit launched production-ready uncrewed surface vessels (B-18, B-39) in Oct 2026, and Red Cat made a public purchase offer for engine maker Steyr Motors.
deep_cut_fact: His first company was EdgeNet, an internet service provider he founded in 1994 and sold to Citadel Broadcasting in 1997. He holds a B.S. from the University of Massachusetts.
notes: Good fit for a defense-tech/entrepreneurship angle. Sources differ on the exact date he became Red Cat CEO (2016-2020).

name: Xiong Ke
current_role: No current public role found; spouse of Long Changming, the actual controller of Guangyi Technology (光一科技, formerly 300356.SZ)
profile: Listed on Hurun China 2016 with Long Changming for wealth from Guangyi Technology, a Nanjing electrical-equipment/power-grid information company on ChiNext that her husband controlled through Guangyi Investment. Filings name her only as Long Changming's spouse; no separate executive role or biography was found.
notes: Not a good outreach target. Guangyi later became *ST Guangyi and filings show heavy debt and guarantee issues; its shares appear to have moved to a delisted-share code (400187). The 2016 Hurun wealth is stale. Source: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202304271585923015_1.pdf

name: Keith Richards
current_role: Guitarist, secondary vocalist and co-principal songwriter, The Rolling Stones
profile: English musician and an original member of the Rolling Stones. His songwriting partnership with Mick Jagger is one of the most successful in history, and his career spans more than six decades. Wealth comes from music royalties and touring. He also has a solo career (latest solo album Crosseyed Heart, 2015) and wrote the bestselling memoir Life (2010).
interesting_fact: Dartford, his hometown, honoured him with a statue in 2023. In 2025 he was the first recipient of the Connecticut Governor's Award of Excellence.
deep_cut_fact: His grandfather Gus Dupree would only let him have the guitar on the shelf once he could reach it, which he called 'the prize of the century'. He turned the story into a 2014 children's book, Gus and Me. As a boy chorister he sang in a trio for Queen Elizabeth II at Westminster Abbey.
notes: Not an obvious fit for an energy/data-center podcast. Approaches go through Rolling Stones management/label. He also produced the 1997 Wingless Angels Rastafarian nyabinghi record on his own Mindless Records label.

name: Wang Renhong
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder, Miracll Chemicals (美瑞新材, 300848.SZ)
profile: Polyurethane chemist and entrepreneur, born 1977. Spent a decade at Wanhua Chemical before founding Yantai-based Miracll in 2009. The ChiNext-listed company makes TPU, PUR and PUD polyurethanes and PBS biodegradable materials for 3C electronics, medical, automotive and 3D printing, shipping to 20+ countries. He holds the controlling stake.
interesting_fact: He is a listed co-inventor on Miracll patents for thermoplastic polyurethane materials, a hands-on technical founder rather than only an investor.
deep_cut_fact: He joined Wanhua Chemical in 1999 straight out of Qingdao University of Science & Technology (chemical process engineering) as a workshop technician, rising to head its TPU department. He later earned an EMBA from HKUST (2009), the year he launched Miracll.
notes: Honours include China's 'Ten Thousand Talents Program' (2019) and Shandong Outstanding Entrepreneur. CEO title ended in Aug 2021 per MarketScreener; he remains chairman. The route is company IR (SZSE filings).

name: Jyoti Kabra
profile: Member of the promoter group of Avenue Supermarts, the DMart supermarket chain founded by her father Radhakishan Damani in 2002. She holds roughly 16.1 million shares (about 2.48%), and her wealth comes from that stake. No executive role or public biography was found.
interesting_fact: DMart was founded in 2002 with its first store in Powai, Mumbai. It listed in 2017 at a premium of over 100% and is known for prioritising cash flow and profitability over rapid expansion.
notes: Private individual with no public role; the Damani family is famously media-shy. Shareholding: https://trendlyne.com/equity/share-holding/53208/DMART/latest/avenue-supermarts-ltd ; Wikidata Q96276869. Not recommended for direct outreach.

name: Zhang Haoyu
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Shenzhen Kaizhong Precision Technology (凯中精密, 002823.SZ)
profile: Born 1961, a mechanical engineer (Huazhong University of Science & Technology; MBA, Peking University Guanghua) and former official in Shandong's provincial machinery department. He and his wife Wu Ying are the actual controllers of Kaizhong Precision, a leading maker of commutators, slip rings and connectors for motors and vehicles. He has chaired the company since at least 2021.
interesting_fact: Kaizhong describes itself as a leader in the commutator industry. Commutators are the precision components that switch current in electric motors, from power tools to automotive motors.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a senior engineer title and is recognised as a Guangdong Province science & technology leading talent. Before business he worked at the Shandong Provincial Machinery Department.
notes: Holds the stake as an overseas natural person (Q1 2025 report: https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-04-28/1223305257.PDF). The route is the company board secretary/IR. Relevant to EV/motor supply-chain themes.

name: Shivinder Singh
current_role: No current operating role; former non-executive vice chairman of Fortis Healthcare
profile: Grandson of Ranbaxy founder Bhai Mohan Singh. He and his brother Malvinder inherited the family's Ranbaxy stake in 1999 and built the Fortis Healthcare hospital chain and the Religare financial group. In April 2015 he was ranked among India's 35 richest people. He no longer has a role in those companies.
interesting_fact: He earned an MBA specialising in health sector management from Duke University's Fuqua School of Business, after a mathematics degree from St. Stephen's College, Delhi, and schooling at The Doon School.
notes: NOT recommended for outreach. Since 2019 he has faced fraud and misappropriation cases over Religare Finvest (arrested 2019, bailed June 2023). In April 2025 he filed a personal insolvency plea at the NCLT (Bar and Bench). The listed net worth is stale.

name: Adnan A. Nisar
current_role: Senior Partner and Co-Head of Knowledge & Learning Solutions, The Vistria Group; director of Phoenix Education Partners (NYSE: PXED)
profile: Private-equity investor at Chicago-based Vistria, which backed Apollo Education Group / University of Phoenix. A Vistria affiliate sold shares in the $136M IPO of Phoenix Education Partners, the University of Phoenix parent. His SEC insider holdings stem from that stake and a board seat. Previously at Mubadala Development Co. (real estate, healthcare) and M3 Capital Partners.
interesting_fact: He also sits on the boards of education companies Academic Partnerships, Vanta Education and Unitek Learning, and formerly Penn Foster and HigherEducation.com.
deep_cut_fact: In a 2024 'Off-duty' interview with Private Equity International he talked about his passion for education, a love of omakase dining and never turning down a beach trip. The headline cites Daft Punk, Bora Bora and molecular gastronomy.
notes: Education: BA Washington University in St. Louis; MBA Chicago Booth. The SEC 10%-owner status likely reflects Vistria fund holdings attributed to him, not purely personal wealth. Director role per the SEC insider data in the lane input.

name: Mao Daqing
current_role: Founder and Chairman of the Board, Ucommune International (Nasdaq: UK)
profile: Former China Vanke executive vice president (2009-2015) and Beijing Vanke chief, and earlier a founding figure at CapitaLand's Beijing business. He left Vanke in 2015 to found UrWork, later Ucommune, one of China's largest co-working operators, which went public on Nasdaq. He has chaired Ucommune's board since June 2021. He holds a management doctorate from Tongji University.
interesting_fact: A prolific marathoner who has run dozens of marathons and co-founded the Forbidden City Marathon. He completed the '777' challenge: seven marathons on seven continents in seven days, including an Antarctic leg of over seven hours in high wind.
deep_cut_fact: He started running at about 43 through a Vanke healthy-living initiative, building from walking to 800 m, 2 km and 5 km, and by 2017 had completed 59 marathons. His motto: 'The slower you run, the farther you can go' (跑得越慢，才能跑得越远).
notes: Role confirmed by Ucommune's 2025 Form 20-F (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001821424/000121390025036276/ea0238772-20f_ucommune.htm). The IR email comes from older (c.2021-22) press releases and may be outdated. Good fit for a real-estate/flexible-workspace entrepreneurship angle; publicly outgoing.
